item.title: Agents of Influence
item.description:
All designs below and cover image are “In Collaboration with Alterea Inc”

Using Figma, I was tasked to redesign some current pages to be more accessible without losing its design allowing for increased text sizing. Continuing from those designs I started to develop tutorial walk-throughs of existing games and eventually finished a skeleton layout using old game design reference to make a bonus game tutorial. Here are some snippets of some of those designs.
